review.reason: Reviewed shared codec and projection extraction into core, host-clock adapters and original selected-transaction receipt lookup. Publication manual retains manifest CAS, native framing, WAL recovery and stable prepared Agent identities.

Reviewed public opaque-binding validation and unchanged canonical domain/provider formats. The optional conversation adapter consumes existing native capture normalization and selected participants without changing AgentStore encodings.

Reviewed additive headless source/progress/acknowledgement profile, optional exact application journal and unchanged default recovery encodings, with private host durability required before acknowledgement.

Reviewed reuse of default-settings read-only JJ workspace discovery and metadata-carrier construction in the library and CLI, including shared repository links, optional identity and explicit host-owned physical authority; no working-copy load, source initialization or head reconciliation.

Reviewed native and local command/status composition through five factories, current principal/epoch admission and private semantic error adapters. Architecture and publication manuals describe exact original receipts and durable preparation; transport and conversion contracts are unchanged.
Reviewed equivalent native read-context iteration after release lint cleanup. Rebuildable search authority and bounded read behavior are unchanged.
Reviewed sync semantic projection suppressing idle scheduler churn while preserving checkpoint, pause and fault notices; replication authority is unchanged.
Reviewed final scoped prompt adapter and immutable command binding; no executable, process, resource selection or provider configuration changes.

Reviewed the unchanged local-folder CLI contract now delegated to reusable default-settings JJ discovery; original safe error categories, read-only inspection and metadata reopening remain intact, without new commands or executable configuration.

Reviewed local Work commands and review/collaboration status adaptation through the existing bounded authorized handlers. HTTP routes, schemas, admission and error semantics remain unchanged; regenerated references include the already-committed repository deletion contract.

Reviewed mechanical mention and delivery projection delegation to the owning built client package; original token bytes, legacy pubkey presentation alias, numeric display conversion, UI labels and operational feedback paths are unchanged.
Reviewed shared native resource verification, complete Lapis helper staging and unchanged service ownership and paired JJ lifecycle.
Reviewed the updated executable example path; public HTTP/RPC DTOs and command fields remain unchanged by local AI client adoption.
Reviewed final owner-bound dispatch lease and exact child-command digest fence; original context/deferred queues and prepared/accepted receipts remain unchanged.
Reviewed Cargo distribution metadata only; read-index source, exact-root fingerprints, posting invariants, bounded retention and native authority separation remain unchanged.

Reviewed equivalent forge let-chain guards after strict Rust lint: stale PR identity rejection, retained navigation context and latest-check filtering preserve short-circuit order and documented submission/check/credential semantics.

Reviewed retained-source metadata validation: selected inventory preserves historical source snapshots while public active-closure reads remain pinned; published store interfaces and SDK usage are unchanged.

Reviewed optional selected Agent/Thread capture, journal-before-IO ordering, retained native preparation, request-aware read-only recovery, exact receipt comparison and host ownership against Git and native-provider fixtures.

Reviewed public ESM/type archive, scoped exact wire requests, status-only unknown recovery and identity-only restoration; full-width sequences and native authority remain distinct from transport receipt presence.

Reviewed strict public inner frames, bounded version-one JSON text request/result envelopes, full-width integer preservation, generated Rust schema equality and unchanged typed service admission, permissions, source pins and lifecycle.

Reviewed generated native-schema types and runtime validation, bounded integer-only decoding, arbitrary record keys, immutable vault scope, explicit closure, transport errors and independent archive/type acceptance without Tauri or source aliases.
